product: Barney dolls
title: Parents Urged To Remove Pom-Pom From Santa Barney; Choking Risk Cited
tell: All 6-inch Santa Barney dolls with a red and white scarf and red Santa hat are recalled; consumers should remove the pom-pom.

product: Molded Plastic Maui Chairs May Collapse
title: Molded Plastic Maui Chairs May Collapse
tell: All units are not recalled; only white molded plastic Maui Plastic Patio Chairs model 1025 are affected.

product: Window blinds - window covering pull cords
title: CPSC And Industry Redesign Products To Save Lives
tell: All units of window covering pull cords are covered by this safety announcement.

product: Gerber Products Company Recalls Nuk Orthodontic Pacifiers
title: Gerber Products Company Recalls Nuk Orthodontic Pacifiers
tell: Check the date code on the back of the package ranging from 070193 to 063094, and any pacifiers without packages should be considered recalled.

product: Bernzomatic Portable Gas Radiant Heater propane gas heaters
title: Bernzomatic Offers $250 Bounty For Old Propane Heaters
tell: Check the instructions inside the rear door for model number TX900 or TX900A and the words Portable Gas Radiant Heater.

product: VitaMini vegetable/fruit juice extractors
title: Krups Recalls Vitamini Juice Extractor, Model Number 290
tell: All units sold before June 1, 1994, model number 290 are recalled. Modified units can be identified by the box labeled NEW! IMPROVED STRAINER AND LID and letters ABS embossed on the basket.

product: Camel Metal Match cigarette lighters
title: R.J. Reynolds Recalls Camel Metal Match Cigarette Lighters
tell: All units are recalled; the lighters resemble a small pack of Camel cigarettes and came in a blue box labelled Camel Metal Match. Free with 2-Pack Purchase.

product: Tech Man extension cords
title: 230,000 Extension Cords Can Catch Fire Or Shock People
tell: Check for item numbers PA-1106S, PA-1109S, PA-1112S, PA-1115S, PA-1118S, or PA-1121S on cardboard sleeves labeled TECH man and 125V.

product: Sub-Zero built-in refrigerators/freezers
title: Sub-Zero Will Inspect Refrigerators That Can Tip Over
tell: Check the model number on a sticker attached to the interior door frame for models 501 and 550 installed between June 1989 and December 1992.

product: Melitta Aroma Brew Automatic Drip coffeemaker
title: Safety Commission Urges Consumers: Check Your Coffeemakers
tell: Check the bottom for Model ACM-10S and the filter holder for the word Melitta; only units sold before Feb. 1, 1994, are included.

product: Latch Fuseholders On Christmas Lights Properly To Prevent Potential Fire Hazard
title: Latch Fuseholders On Christmas Lights Properly To Prevent Potential Fire Hazard
tell: All units of this product are recalled; check for the 1.5-inch plastic Gilbert fuseholder on the cord with text reading Fuseholder, 125V., 7A. Max.

product: Char-Broil charcoal water smokers
title: Char-Broil Offers Free Kit For Charcoal Water Smokers
tell: Only smokers labeled Char-Broil H2O Smoker on the body that have a hole in the exposed charcoal pan are involved.

product: Shure Products, Toys R Us Recall Art Set With Lead Poisoning Hazard
title: Shure Products, Toys R Us Recall Art Set With Lead Poisoning Hazard
tell: All units of this art set are recalled.

product: Brinkman charcoal water smokers
title: Brinkmann Provides Free Kit For Charcoal Water Smokers
tell: Look for the Brinkmann or Cook'N Ca'Jun name on the smoker and check if the charcoal pan at the bottom has a hole. Only units manufactured before 1993 are included.

product: Stihl chain saws
title: Stihl Recalls Certain Model Chain Saws
tell: Recalled model 029 saws have serial numbers 226585676 and above, and model 039 saws have serial numbers 227236569 and above. The model number is on top of the engine and the serial number is stamped on the housing near…

product: HydraBath whirlpool bath suction covers
title: Hair Entrapment Danger In Whirlpool Bath Suction Covers
tell: The recalled round covers feature slotted or square-shaped holes larger than 1/8 inch with no visible markings; covers distributed after 1985 have circular holes 1/8 inch or smaller and HB-8, SC-1, or SC-4 markings.

product: Best Wear girls romper garment sets with stuffed dolls and necklaces
title: Best Wear, Inc. Recalls Girls Rompers
tell: Check for style numbers 84P1580, 84P1581, or 84P1065 on the labels which read Baby's 2 PCS ROMPER/DOLL or Baby's 3 PCS BLOUSE/ROMPER/DOLL.

product: CPSC Recalls Dangerously Flammable Imported Chiffon Skirts
title: CPSC Recalls Dangerously Flammable Imported Chiffon Skirts
tell: All units are not recalled; affected skirts are long, full rayon or rayon-cotton blend skirts with two layers, made in India, stating 100 percent rayon or 65 percent rayon/35 percent cotton on the label.

product: Oxygen Krypton (KR) model inline skates
title: Atomic Ski Usa, Inc. Recalls Certain Inline Rollerskates
tell: Check the model number on the skates to see if it matches KR01, KR03, KR03L, KR05, or KR05L.

product: Future Shok mountain bike suspension forks
title: 1992 "Future Shock" Suspension Bicycle Forks Recalled
tell: In 1992 models, the stanchion tubes do not pass through the fork crown, unlike later non-recalled models where they do pass through.

product: Productos Electricos Corona tankless electric water heaters
title: Tankless Water Heaters May Explode
tell: All series CTH-10 and CTH-40 tankless electric water heaters are recalled.

product: Star Sales Company Inc. Recalls "Baby Snack" And "Boat And Trailer" Toy Sets
title: Star Sales Company Inc. Recalls "Baby Snack" And "Boat And Trailer" Toy Sets
tell: All units are recalled. The snack set is labeled No 1231 and the boat and trailer set is labeled No 9882 on the cardboard backing.

product: Gerry Baby Products Company Good Vibes Infant Carriers
title: Gerry Recalls Some "Good Vibes" Infant Carriers
tell: Check for date codes molded inside the back of the handle where the left circle has 93 in the center with an arrow pointing to 9, and the right circle has an arrow pointing to 2.

product: Remco Scented Teethers
title: Toxic Teether Recalled
tell: All units are recalled. They are pink or blue hand or foot shapes with embossed text 'AHI MADE IN CHINA' along the center hole.

product: Certain Lawn-Boy Mowers Recalled For Brake Adjustment
title: Certain Lawn-Boy Mowers Recalled For Brake Adjustment
tell: Check the model number and serial number on the label located between the handles on the mower housing; only specific serial ranges for models 10201 and 10301 purchased before January 1, 1994, are included.

product: Atlas Imports Alien Invasion multiple-tube fireworks
title: Fireworks Recalled by Various Companies
tell: All units of the recalled multiple-tube fireworks distributed by the named companies are included; check the brand and product names printed on the packaging.

product: Black & Decker Under-the-Cabinet automatic drip coffee makers
title: Under-The-Cabinet Coffeemakers Recalled by Black & Decker & GE
tell: Check for date codes from 406 through 822, which is a three-digit number located on the outside of the plug prong.

product: tag three-foot citronella-scented paper- wrapped torches
title: tag's Voluntary Recall Of Three-Foot Citronella-Scented Paper Wrapped Lawn Torch
tell: All units of item R2J multi-colored paper-wrapped torches are recalled; check the packaging near the base of the candle for the name tag and item number R2J.

product: Diplomat 2 Pacifiers
title: Dangerous Pacifiers Recalled
tell: All units of this product are recalled. The pacifier nipple has 'Latex Pur' embossed on the side.

product: Fastblast Color Refill Assortment craft set refills
title: Kenner Recalls "Fastblast Spray Art Design" And "Fastblast Color Refills
tell: Check the model number 60090 for the craft set or 60091 for the color refill assortment printed on the product.

product: Cosco Youth Options Toddler Bed Guard Rails
title: Cosco Recalls Two-Rod Guard Rails For Toddler Beds; Asphyxiation Risk Cited
tell: Recalled guard rails have a tubular metal frame with two thin horizontal metal rods. Versions with three rods or for full size beds are not involved.

product: Hunter Fan Company ceiling fan remote controls
title: Hunter Fan Company Recalls Wireless Remote
tell: You can identify the recalled unit by model 22788 and serial numbers ranging from 029936 to 051679 located on a name plate on top of the unit's receiver.

product: International Express Manufacturing tubular metal frame bunk beds
title: International Express Manufacturing Recalls Tubular Metal Bunk Beds; Collapsing Risk Cited
tell: Look for a gold sticker on the head or footboard that says IEM and International Express Mfg., and check if the model is 504, 508, or 510.

product: World Imports tubular metal frame bunkbeds
title: World Imports Ltd. Recalls Tubular Metal Bunk Beds; Collapsing Risk Cited
tell: You can identify the recalled beds by their C-shaped headboard and footboard frames, model numbers 02-2332, 02-2343, 02-2354, or 02-2365, and a gold Warning label on the top of the C-shaped end frame.

product: MPC Trading Company high-gloss tubular metal frame bunk beds
title: MPC Trading Company's Tubular Metal Bunk Beds Recalled; Collapsing Risk Cited
tell: Check for model 3013 or 3012 high-gloss tubular metal frames in red, blue, black, or white sold by MPC Trading Company.

product: Surprise Party Time Ball toys
title: Surprise Party Time Ball Toy Contains Look-Alike--Drug Capsules
tell: All units of this product are recalled; the three-inch balls are wrapped in multi-colored crepe paper and have a sticker that reads MADE IN TAIWAN.

product: Candy Filled Toy Funglasses Are A Choking Hazard
title: Candy Filled Toy Funglasses Are A Choking Hazard
tell: All units of this product are included in this recall.

product: Troll Associates Basic Skills Puzzle Sets
title: Toy Puzzles Recalled Due To Potential Choking Hazard
tell: All units are recalled. The puzzles feature red plastic pegs on each piece and are labeled with specific titles such as Hatch-A-Chick or Learning World.

product: Hartman hair dryers
title: Model Pro1600 Hair Dryers Recalled; Fire Risk Cited
tell: You can identify a recalled unit by looking at the back for a black fan on beige model PRO1600 hair dryers; those with gray fans are not involved.

product: Ground Fault Interrupter Extension Cord Recalled Due To Electric Shock Hazard
title: Ground Fault Interrupter Extension Cord Recalled Due To Electric Shock Hazard
tell: All units are recalled. You can identify the recalled cord by model GF1812, its white color, 12-foot length, and a red RESET button on the plug with specific warning and catalog numbers embossed.

product: Dell DL-1460NI Computer Monitors Recalled Due To Fire Risk
title: Dell DL-1460NI Computer Monitors Recalled Due To Fire Risk
tell: Check for model number DL-1460NI printed on the back of the monitor.

product: See-Thru Bi-Plane toys
title: Toy Bi-Plane Recalled Due To Potential Choking Hazards
tell: All units are recalled. You can identify the toy by model number C9071, a decal on the top wing reading 907 Skeletplane, and embossing underneath the lower wing.

product: Baby's Bucket-Sorting Toys Recalled Due To Potential Choking Hazards
title: Baby's Bucket-Sorting Toys Recalled Due To Potential Choking Hazards
tell: All units are recalled. You can identify the recalled toy by model number 3848 and box text reading Madison Ltd., Hackensack, NJ.

product: Gerry Baby Products Company's Splash Seats
title: Replacement Suction Cups Offered For Gerry Splash Seats
tell: Check the color of the suction cups; affected seats have white suction cups.

product: Etna Products Company, Inc. Recalls Toy Wagon Due To Choking And Lead Hazard
title: Etna Products Company, Inc. Recalls Toy Wagon Due To Choking And Lead Hazard
tell: All units are recalled. You can identify the recalled toy by checking the box label for item number 9638 and MADE IN CHINA.

product: Wooden Armadillo toys
title: Colbert Collection Recalls Wooden Armadillos Due To Lead Paint Hazards
tell: All units are recalled. You can identify them by the label underneath that reads HECHO EN MEXICO (MADE IN MEXICO).

product: Walgreen's electric potpourri pots
title: Walgreen Co. Recalls Its Electric Potpourri Pots
tell: You can tell a recalled unit by checking the bottom of the pot for model number WA-00117 and verifying it lacks a UL listing mark.

product: Scotsman Home Ice Cube Machines
title: Scotsman To Retrofit Home Ice Cube Machines
tell: Check the model number and date code on the label affixed to the left side of the machine's base behind the front grill, and on the control box cover.

product: Deary Baby Rattle Baby Soother Spain Style pacifiers
title: Eugene Trading, Inc. Recalls Deary Baby Pacifier
tell: All units are recalled. They have a pink, yellow, or blue guard and ring sold in a plastic bubble package reading Deary Baby Rattle Baby Soother Spain Style.

product: Loomis Citronella Scented Lawn Torches
title: Loomis Sales Co. Recalls 33-Inch Citronella Scented Lawn Torch, Item GE221
tell: All units of item GE221 33-inch citronella scented lawn torches distributed by Loomis Sales Co. are recalled.

product: Levi Strauss Jeans
title: Levi Strauss & Company Recalls Toddlers Coveralls
tell: Identify recalled garments by the product codes listed on the underside of the garment matching the specified model numbers for boys and girls styles.

product: Tim Mee Toy Thunderbat yellow hard plastic sound- making baseball bats
title: 172,000 Children's "Thunderbat" Noisemaker Plastic Bats Recalled
tell: This recall applies only to Thunderbats with yellow end caps, with model numbers 39600, 39603, 39604, and 39606.

product: Playskool Weebles Tractor toys
title: Weebles Tractor Toys Recall by Playskool
tell: All units are recalled. Item number 5242 is imprinted into the bottom of the tractor.

product: American Camper Rope Hammocks
title: Certain Rope Hammocks May Collapse During Use
tell: All American Camper NY90 rope hammocks are recalled; the entire quantity is included in this recall.

product: Kmart boys' newborn 3-piece outfits
title: Kmart Corporation Recalls Infant's Clothing Outfit
tell: Identify the outfits by the hangtag stating Dept. 2116, M4311, Style 2129, Item 4200, located underneath the left arm of the garments when sold.

product: Golden Apple American Spirit disposable tractor trailer cigarette lighters
title: Novelty "Tractor Trailer" Cigarette Lighters Recalled
tell: All units are recalled. They are tractor-trailer shaped with an apple engraved on the flue and a caution sticker on the back stating Made in Philippines.

product: S&A Imports high gloss tubular metal frame bunk beds
title: S&A Imports,Inc. Recalls Tubular Metal Bunk Beds; Collapsing Risk Cited
tell: Affected models are 6202B, 6202L, 6202R, and 6202W, featuring protruding metal mattress support tongues extending from corner posts.

product: Gold Key Enterprises Recalls Tubular Metal Bunk Beds; Collapsing Risk Cited
title: Gold Key Enterprises Recalls Tubular Metal Bunk Beds; Collapsing Risk Cited
tell: All units distributed from 1988 through September 1993 are recalled, identified by protruding metal mattress support tongues and distinctive scroll work.

product: Fashion Bed Group Double Decker tubular metal frame children's bunk beds
title: Fashion Bed Group Recalls Tubular Metal Bunk Beds; Collapsing Risk Cited
tell: All units of the Slumberama and Double Decker metal bunk beds are recalled.

product: Bernards high gloss tubular metal frame children's bunk beds
title: CPSC Announces Repair-Recall Of Imported Bunk Beds Because Of A Collapsing Risk
tell: All Gold Key beds purchased from 1988 through 1993 are affected. Bernards models 354, 364, 464, and 465 are affected. Contact the retailer or importer to determine if your bed is included.

product: Bernards, Inc. Recalls Tubular Metal Bunk Beds; Collapsing Risk Cited
title: Bernards, Inc. Recalls Tubular Metal Bunk Beds; Collapsing Risk Cited
tell: All twin-size on top over full-size on bottom Pyramid and Broadway model beds distributed from May 1992 through August 1992 with protruding metal mattress support tongues are affected.

product: Baum Crayons
title: CPSC Announces Recalls Of Imported Crayons Because Of Lead Poisoning Hazard
tell: All units of the named imported crayon brands and models are recalled.

product: Designer's Edge Mighty Lite halogen clamp lights
title: Designers Edge Recalls Halogen Clamp Lights; Potential Shock Hazard
tell: Check the lamp cord for a date code if purchased at Yardbirds; lamps without a date code and all lamps from Sears are recalled. Yardbirds lamps with a date code are not affected.

product: Concord Enterprise jumbo crayons
title: CPSC And Concord Enterprises Announce Recall Of Certain Crayons Because Of Lead Poisoning Hazard
tell: The recall involves Concord Enterprise jumbo crayons sold in a plastic box bearing the labels 12 Jumbo Crayons, Made in China, and Non-Toxic, specifically affecting the yellow and orange color crayons.

product: Montgomery Ward high gloss tubular metal frame children's bunk beds
title: Montgomery Ward & Co., Incorporated, Tubular Metal Bunk Beds; Risk Of Collapse Cited
tell: Affected beds have model number 66-72995 in red or white without a center fifth leg on the lower full size bed portion.

product: Beef Iron And Wine Liquid Recalled
title: Beef Iron And Wine Liquid Recalled
tell: You can tell a recalled unit by its white conventional screw-on cap instead of child-resistant packaging on brown plastic bottles labeled Beef-Iron and Wine.

product: Pier 1 Imports wooden pull toys
title: Pier 1 Imports Recalls Pull Toys
tell: All units are recalled. You can identify the toy by a white sticker on the underside of the base reading Made in Sri Lanka 1197598 100/1001 7.99.

product: Powell tubular metal frame children's bunk beds
title: L. Powell Company, Inc. Begins Repair Program For Children's Tubular Metal Bunk Beds
tell: Check the model number and color: model 440 is red, 446 is white, 447 is blue, and 448 is black.

product: Dubby Pacifier Thermometers
title: M.J. Harris And Associates Recall Pacifier Thermometer
tell: All units are recalled. They are pink or blue with a clear silicon rubber nipple and the name Dubby printed on the top panel of the blue box.

product: Enzymatic Therapy, Inc. Recalls Iron Product Without Child-Resistant Packaging
title: Enzymatic Therapy, Inc. Recalls Iron Product Without Child-Resistant Packaging
tell: This recall applies only to Fem-Plus packaged in white, opaque plastic bottles with blue conventional screw caps instead of white child-resistant caps.

product: Reeves International, Inc. Recalls Kouvalias Music Toy Due To Potential Choking Hazards
title: Reeves International, Inc. Recalls Kouvalias Music Toy Due To Potential Choking Hazards
tell: All units of model number 960 are recalled, with the label underneath the base reading A. Kouvalias S.A. MADE IN GREECE.

product: Little Tikes High Back Toddler Swings
title: Little Tikes Company Offers Free Seat Belt To Prevent Falls From High Back Toddler Swing
tell: Recalled swings are Model 4309 manufactured between January 1993 and September 1993 that do not have a pre-installed seat belt; the Little Tikes label is on the T-bar across the front.

product: Dillon Importing Company Recalls Toy Jewelry
title: Dillon Importing Company Recalls Toy Jewelry
tell: Check the item number on the jewelry or packaging, and look for the label reading MGNOV MADE IN CHINA on the bracelets.

product: Condolier single light holiday electric candle decorations
title: Kmart Recalling Holiday Candolier Because Of Electric Shock And Fire Hazard
tell: All units are recalled. You can tell by the item number 04-12-11 or code number 112 3397, or by the 10-inch cream colored single-light design.

product: Holiday Brass Candle Lamp Recalled By Loomco International
title: Holiday Brass Candle Lamp Recalled By Loomco International
tell: You can identify the recalled lamps by item number 95062 and boxes labeled Trimmings Etc. and Handcrafted in Taiwan for Bradlees Department Stores.

product: Convert-a-Cradle Swings
title: Graco Announces Carrier Swing Seat Retrofit To Prevent Falls From Infant Swings
tell: Check if the detachable carrier seat handle adjusts to three positions; swings with two positions do not need a retrofit.

product: Target Stores Recalls Artificial Pine Christmas Trees And Accompanying Extension Cords: Fire Risk Cited
title: Target Stores Recalls Artificial Pine Christmas Trees And Accompanying Extension Cords: Fire Risk Cited
tell: All units of this product are recalled.

product: Telebrands Recalls Sweda Juice Factory Electric Juicers Sold Only At Jamesway & Caldor Stores
title: Telebrands Recalls Sweda Juice Factory Electric Juicers Sold Only At Jamesway & Caldor Stores
tell: All units of the Sweda Juice Factory electric juicer made in China and sold at Jamesway and Caldor after April 1, 1992, are included in this recall.

product: Southern Enterprises high gloss tubular metal frame children's bunk beds
title: Southern Enterprises, Inc. Offers Reinforcement Bracket For Children's Tubular Metal Bunkbeds
tell: Check the model number BB-104-2, BB-105-2, BB-106-2, or BB-107-2 and rectangular mattress support side rails measuring 3/4-inch by 1-1/2 inches on high gloss tubular metal frames.

product: Good Time Troll cigarette lighters
title: New York Lighter Company Recalls "Good Time Troll" Cigarette Lighters
tell: All units are recalled. The lighters feature troll designs and have the words THAILAND and C-LITE printed on the flue.

product: Cannon Falls children's toy necklaces, bracelets
title: Lead Paint Hazard: Midwest Importers Recalls Children's Necklaces And Bracelets
tell: All units are recalled. They are made of blue, pink, purple, and yellow wooden beads with white rabbits and orange carrots on elastic strings.
